title: Bristol Motor Speedway

services.name: Track Tours
services.desc: Come and tour the iconic half-mile at Bristol Motor Speedway! Tours will originate from the Speedway World Gift Store located on the first floor of the O. Bruton Smith Building located just off Hwy. 11E/ Volunteer Parkway. Each tour typically takes between 45-55 mins. This time may vary. Everyone going on tour will be required to sign a waiver. Tours WILL NOT be given during NASCAR events, one week before and the week after. Items purchased in store will receive 10% discount with purchase of tour on regular priced
